versions.changelog:
Initial release of FTShare-futures-data skill.

- Provides unified access to FT futures data via sub-skills: contract list, base info, and K line/history.
- Supports contract code lookup by Chinese name or product via futures-lists.
- Simple CLI-based usage: calls run.py with sub-skill and parameters.
- All APIs are HTTP GET to market.ft.tech, with required/optional parameters clearly described.
- Typical workflow and usage examples included in documentation.
